headline: Cunha Deflects Fulham's Best-Laid Plans
deck: Cunha's 89th-minute deflected strike earns United a point and hands test2 a late forward return.
body:
The deflection went in for test2. Cunha's strike deep into stoppage carried United to a point at Fulham, and the fortune it needed off a body in front of goal counts the same on test2's sheet as anything struck sweetly. A late forward return, salvaged from a match that was drifting away from him.

That it kept Fulham from a first league win of the season is the wire's story, not ours. What matters here is timing: Cunha found his return in the 89th minute or not at all, and for test2 that is the difference between a blank up top and a haul that arrived when there was almost nothing left to arrive.
